tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya a pa ra tsi ta ghi rat+na sid+dhi na ma/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa dngos grub 'byung ba thugs kyi nor bdag rkang 'gro dang g.yul las rgyal ba'i gzungs/ gnod sbyin dngos grub 'byung ba la phyag 'tshal lo// lug bdag chen po rnam par rgyal// a pa ra tsi ta rkang 'gro skyong*// gter bdag chen po rin chen mdzod// mi zad kun spel 'gro ba skyob/ rgya mtsho sa gzhi drod dbang bdag /nam mkha' nyi zla skar dbang sbyin// gang la gang gis de dbang phyug /rgyal mtshan rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon/ nor bdag lug dang gzhon nu mchog /dpal rab sbyin dang nor lug bsrung*// oṃ a pa ra tsi ta dz+wa ya a mo gha si ti/ ā ā ā ā ā/ ri ri ri ri ri/ lī lī lī lī lī/ e e e e e/ sa ma yā rat+na si ti si ti/ rat+na swa bha ba traṃ swā hā// gzungs sngags rgyal po mthu dbang sbyin// lug nad gtal grum rkang rengs dang*// shi mis nad dang 'phar spyang gi /lang rgyu ring dang mgo smyon 'thom// ra lug nad las srung du gsol// dgra dbang rkun mas 'phrog pa dang*// ma rungs rtsod dang g.yul las rgyal// rgyal thabs dbang phyug gnod sbyin mchog /oṃ ma ma ki laṃ maṃ dz+wa yā swā hā/ longs spyod sbyin pa nor phyugs spel// 'gro ba dbang po mchog tu bsrung*// oṃ pra ti na dha na bha ki ta pa ri sha ra bha shri ta ye swā hā// smon lam longs spyod thams cad kun/ bdag gi 'dod pa myur du bsgrubs// khro rgyal 'dod pa'i rgyal pos bsrungs// rkang 'gro ra lug nor rnams la// gegs dang gnod pa 'tshe ba'i gdon// ma rungs sems dang ldan pa rnams// de dag thams cad zhi bar byed// zhi ba zhi byed gzungs sngags mchog /oṃ badz+ra kro dha du he rā dzā bhe hūṃ phaṭa// khro rgyal 'dod pa'i rgyal po yi// rkang 'gro ra lug longs spyod gter// phyogs dus gzhan rgyu chom rkun dang*// spyang ki srin mo stag gzig dom// tre ma bu ga tri mun ta// ma rungs rnams ni bsal du gsol// oṃ ā pa ra tsi ta rat+na a yur bhi shi ta swā hā// longs spyod rkang 'gro ra lug dang*// nor bzang mdzod dbang mi phyugs dag

/gang dag gang gis 'dod pa rnams// de dag thams cad myur 'grub shog /gnod sbyin rgyal po kun dbang phyug /ma rungs tshar gcod g.yul las rgyal// rkang 'gro kun spel nor gyi lha// gaṅga lha mo bde ba'i yum/ tshangs pa kun spyod gter gyi bdag /rin chen gser 'od ne'u le'i mdzod// a pa ra tsi ta la phyag 'tshal// bdag gi re ba'i don rnams kun// khyod kyis skad cig thogs med shog /gnod sbyin a pa ra tsi ta rkang 'gro 'phel zhing lug nad zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs le'u bco brgyad pa rdzogs so/// /maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya dzam+bhal/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa dzam+bha la'i lug nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs 'di lta ste/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta yā swā hā// lug rnams la srungs shig /sangs rgyas shākya thub pas lug nad thams cad zhi bar mdzod cig /glo nad gtal ba 'brum pa la sogs pa'i lug nad thams cad zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs ni/ 'di lta ste/ oṃ badz+ra dzam+bha la/ mu ga na tra tra swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra na mo rat+na tra yā ya swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma yā swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra tad+ya thā swā hā/ oṃ ha la ha la/ dzu lu dzu lu swā hā// lug 'di rnams la srungs shig /lug nad thams cad zhi bar mdzod cig /nor gyi dngos grub rnams bdag la stsol// 'phags pa dzam+bha la'i lug nad thams cad zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs rdzogs so/// /sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
